fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, so no owner interview. The planner read the change set's intent, the code (newPlanChange in internal/api/run.go opens a plan request's change set in the main checkout before the run's worktree exists; workspace.writeEntry in internal/api/workspace.go is the one place model entries are written), and the earlier Decisions on main-clone entries (decision-run-carries-accept, close-out-untracked-log-and-retry). It raised four choices to the arbiter: which intent the change set serves, where a main-checkout write lives until main has it, how existing untracked entries move onto a branch, and how loudly health and check report them. The arbiter answered with Decision decision-main-writes-get-a-branch: serve milestone-25; a main-checkout write still lands in the main checkout's log and in the same operation is committed onto a short-lived model branch from origin/main in a temporary worktree, pushed and opened as a model-only PR that the daemon squash-merges on green, later writes to the same change set joining that branch; the daemon (each tick) and a CLI command move orphaned untracked entries onto model branches the same way; health reports an orphan as a problem and lists entries held by a model branch as pending; rhiza check warns in a main checkout only. The plan's leaves: run start --new opens the change set only in the run's worktree; writes for a change set with a live run also go into that run's worktree; main-checkout writes get a model branch and PR; the daemon merges model PRs; orphans are committed by the daemon and by rhiza model commit-untracked; health and check report orphans.
fields.title: Plan of change set 01M76F26: nothing Rhiza writes is left uncommitted in the main checkout
